primary_question: Can the layer-27 residual-stream refusal-signal result be strengthened into component-level or path-level causal evidence?
secondary_question: Can any SAE-based feature method outperform mean-difference/probe baselines under held-out evaluation without test retuning?

H2_component_specificity.success: component harmful suppression >= 50% of matched residual suppression, CI high < 0, abs(benign_delta) <= 0.03, capability_nll_delta <= 0.05

H3_sae_utility.success: SAE beats mean-difference and logistic probe on specificity/capability utility, direct paired harmful comparison, and matched random controls p <= 0.05

H4_circuit_claim.success: necessity, sufficiency, specificity, and held-out replication evidence

stopping_rules: stop after two OOM failures at the same scale
stop if GPU conflict with another user is detected
do not alter layers, thresholds, scales, feature counts, prompts, bootstrap settings, or success criteria after held-out results
document infeasible 1000-pair or 3B runs as unrun
